subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw solve this by adding a compatible payload-level final-only policy, by making channel replies explicit-message-tool-only, or by continuing targeted sanitizer fixes while preserving automatic bare replies?
rationale: The source-backed leak is real and security-sensitive, but the durable fix changes user-visible channel delivery semantics and can break deployments that rely on automatic final assistant replies.

options.title: Approve payload-level final-only policy
options.body: Add or approve a bounded final-only/last-segment policy at buildEmbeddedRunPayloads or below so interactive and cron delivery share the same suppression behavior, with upgrade docs and real-channel proof.

options.title: Switch to explicit message-tool delivery
options.body: Make affected channel contexts require message(action=send) for visible output, accepting the compatibility risk for agents that currently rely on bare final text replies.

options.title: Keep targeted sanitizer fixes only
options.body: Continue fixing raw tool/reasoning leak shapes one by one, which minimizes compatibility churn but leaves phase-less interim prose risk unresolved.

recommendation.title: Approve payload-level final-only policy
recommendation.body: Add or approve a bounded final-only/last-segment policy at buildEmbeddedRunPayloads or below so interactive and cron delivery share the same suppression behavior, with upgrade docs and real-channel proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses compatibility, security, and channel delivery policy, and this person appears in the merged history for the central phase-aware delivery work.
